recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a large black field of negative space at the top containing layered typography, with a central photographic window framed by rounded corners showing three men on a wooden sailboat at sea.
coreVisualRelationships: Large black negative space dominates the top half, creating a heavy visual weight above the image.
The photographic window uses a 'stadium' or rounded-corner rectangle shape to soften the transition from the black frame.
Layered typography uses a large, low-contrast background acronym behind a smaller, high-contrast foreground name.
Warm, natural lighting in the photo contrasts with the flat, graphic black of the surrounding frame.
coreInvariants: Rounded corners on the photographic inset

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic subject is centered horizontally in the lower two-thirds of the frame, occupying approximately 60% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the white shirt and orange hat acts as the focal point within the photo, while the white text anchors the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright white text at the top, moves down into the large photographic window, and scans the three figures from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space at the top and sides creates a 'letterboxed' or framed effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black serves as the primary framing color.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the primary typography and the central figure's shirt.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm wood tones, ocean blue, and a pop of orange from a knit cap.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The frame is zero-saturation; the photo features medium saturation with warm, sun-drenched values.

letterConstructionRules: Thick vertical strokes with delicate horizontal serifs
Overlapping characters in the background layer
characterSpecificRedesigns: Background acronym is scaled to roughly 300% of the foreground text height
Foreground text is placed directly over the center of the background letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Superimposed layers of the same or similar typeface family in different weights and colors.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded weight for the background acronym
Standard high-contrast serif for the foreground text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a solid black top half and a photographic bottom half. The photo should be inside a rounded-corner rectangle, showing three men in casual 1970s attire sitting on the deck of a wooden sailboat at sea during golden hour.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two layers of centered text at the top. The bottom layer should be a large, dark grey acronym with touching letters. The top layer should be a smaller, bright white serif name string centered over the acronym.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered at the top?
Are the background letters touching or overlapping?

adjustableVariables: Corner radius of the photo window
Vertical position of the text cluster
mustRedesign: Exact boat name or rigging details
postGenerationChecks: Check for 70s film grain in the photo
Verify the 'stadium' shape of the photo window
Confirm the black field is uniform
recipe.reuseFormula: Square format + Black header + Rounded-corner photo window + Layered serif typography = Retro Folk-Rock Aesthetic
